_about: Which subject owns a path, shared by tests/test_viewer_subject_ownership.py (tit/server/routes/viewers.py subject_of_path, behind the two-subject refusal of POST /api/view/open) and desktop/tests/unit/viewer-subject-ownership.test.ts (desktop/src/renderer/pages/viewer/lib.ts subjectOfPath / rescopeToSubject). groundTruth: authored -- owners are written by hand from the BIDS layout rule, not produced by either implementation: the first DIRECTORY named sub-<id> owns everything beneath it, whether it sits under the project root (raw BIDS, sourcedata) or under derivatives/<pipeline>/ at any depth (SimNIBS, fastsurfer, freesurfer, qsiprep, the nested qsirecon tree, ti-toolbox/reports|tissue_analysis). The id is the whole directory name after 'sub-', dots included, so sub-1.2 and sub-1 never merge. A 'sub-' inside a file name (HarvardOxford-sub-maxprob) or a folder below the owner (a simulation a person named sub-foo) is not a subject. owner null = belongs to nobody (the bundled MNI template and atlases, FreeSurfer's fsaverage, group outputs), which a scene may always mix in. Paths are container paths, the form the Viewer's file list and the server both carry. Layout checked against Dataset 000 (derivatives/{SimNIBS,fastsurfer,freesurfer,qsiprep,qsirecon/derivatives/qsirecon-DSIStudio,ti-toolbox/reports}) on 2026-10-22.
